name: mexodigital.com
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But HSTS is not sent.
lesson: Send Strict-Transport-Security with a max-age of at least a year, so browsers never try plain http again.
summary: mexodigital.com scores 68 out of 100 (D). 4 checks fail now, 35 are at risk, and 29 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: 108 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /about-us/, /service-page/, /contact/ and 16 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Links must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 12 elements on /, /about-us/, /service-page/, for example .elementor-element-12213f0.vamtam-sticky-header[data-id="12213f0"]:nth-child(1) > .elementor-column-gap-no.elementor-con and .e-loop-item-1391 >…
fix.fix: Give each link text, or an aria-label when it only holds an icon.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: 20 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /, /about-us/, /service-page/, /contact/ and 16 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: Elements must have their visible text as part of their accessible name
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 3 elements on /, /about-us/, /service-page/, for example .Whatsapp-channel. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Start the aria-label with the words that are visible on the control.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 601 ms
Every external link that was checked answered
